title: When the Horizon Burns Anew
author: Wendell Almeida
blurb: Orsen Whitlock, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
